name: 南开大学
character: The main Balitai campus is surrounded by rivers and features a 'two lakes and one river' water system with lotus-filled lakes, historic halls, and tree-lined scenery.

landmarks.name: 马蹄湖
landmarks.quote: 马蹄湖（原北马蹄湖）位于大中路北侧，为马蹄形湖泊
landmarks.look: A horseshoe-shaped lake with a peninsula and blooming summer lotuses.

landmarks.name: 思源堂
landmarks.quote: 2019年10月，思源堂被被核定为全国重点文物保护单位。
landmarks.look: A historic university hall, plain and dignified.

landmarks.name: 周恩来纪念碑
landmarks.quote: 湖中半岛建有1979年南开大学建校60周年时设立的周恩来纪念碑
landmarks.look: A monument on a lake peninsula inscribed with gilded Chinese characters.

landmarks.name: 新开湖
landmarks.quote: 校内分布有马蹄湖、新开湖及小引河，形成“两湖一河”的水系格局。
landmarks.look: A plain campus lake forming part of the campus water system.

landmarks.name: 南开大学体育中心
landmarks.quote: 2006年10月，南开大学体育中心竣工及投用，是南开大学自建校以来单体建筑面积最大
landmarks.look: A massive modern sports complex, the largest single building on campus.

landmarks.name: 东门
landmarks.quote: 校区主干道为大中路，东起东门，西至化学学院楼。
landmarks.look: A plain university gate at the eastern end of the main road.

landmarks.name: 陈省身墓园
landmarks.quote: 此外，陈省身墓园位于校园内津河北岸。
landmarks.look: A quiet riverside memorial garden on the north bank of Jin River.

landmarks.name: 化学学院楼
landmarks.quote: 校区主干道为大中路，东起东门，西至化学学院楼。
landmarks.look: A plain academic building at the western end of the main road.
